originality.rationale: Fused 3-direction literature search (20 results, no partial failure) finds AAIY as nearest prior. AAIY full text proves occurrence only for Sperner s<=5 and explicitly states s=6 potentials from Theorem 3.9 were not verified as occurring, leaving occurrence as conjectural Question 4.13. No table, database, thesis lead, or broader census found covers these computed realizations; potentials do not imply occurrence.
